title: Investigation decision
purpose: Record, or revise before the review, whether a complaint will be investigated and why.
summary: Record the decision to investigate a complaint or not, with the rationale. The assignee or a supervisor does this, before the independent review.

tasks.title: Record the decision
steps: Explain it in [[Rationale]] and select [[Record decision]].

tasks.title: Revise a decision before the review
steps: On the complaint section select [[Revise decision]], change the choice or the rationale and select [[Record decision]].

good_to_know: Only the ticket's assignee or a supervisor can record or revise the decision. Others are refused.
The person who records the decision cannot review the complaint. Revising it makes you the person who recorded it.
Once a supervisor has reviewed the complaint, its record can no longer change.
Only a ticket that is a complaint has this page; for any other ticket it answers Not found.

sections.title: Fields and actions
paragraphs: Opens from the Complaint section of the ticket page, as a dialog or a full page. When a decision already exists the form starts with it. The form remembers the version of the ticket you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused and you reload.

items.label: Decision
items.description: Required: Investigate or No investigation needed.

items.label: Rationale
items.description: Required. Why you decided that. Shown on the ticket page and to the reviewer.

items.label: Record decision
items.description: Saves and confirms Decision recorded. The ticket page shows the decision, who recorded it and when, and a timeline event. Each revision replaces the shown decision; the earlier one stays in the audit history.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the ticket without changing anything.

sections.title: Rules

items.label: Who may record
items.description: The ticket's assignee, or a supervisor (including the admin role). A ticket with no assignee can be decided by supervisors only.

items.label: Reviewer independence
items.description: The reviewer must be a supervisor who did not record the decision and has never been the ticket's assignee. The decision's recorder is therefore excluded from reviewing. Plan who records it.

items.label: After the review
items.description: A reviewed complaint's record is closed: this page refuses with "This complaint has been reviewed; its record no longer changes."

paragraphs: Opening this form, and drawing it again after a refused save, is recorded with your account and the time (never what the form shows), and supervisors read it on the ticket's Who opened it.
